decisions.reason: The product has shown market acceptance ("viele Freunde") and remains a viable option with low keeping costs, so it is kept.
The recent investment in EU Stage V technology signals continued commitment and the option's uncertainty is not resolved negatively, so it is kept.
The product gained its own page in 2019, suggesting increasing focus and option value, so it is kept.
Specific customer applications (DW 256 Ceron Type B, SST 720) demonstrate realized value, making the option valuable and drop unlikely.
